content: this is a summary of a legal case that took place in the klaipeda district court the court has made a final resolution regarding the division of matrimonial property between two parties involved in the case the immovable property an apartment will be divided equally the movable property will be compensated with eur 5915 for the applicant and eur 1210 for the defendant the defendant will also pay an additional compensation of eur 4705 to account for their greater share of the movable property the court has declared that both parties are jointly responsible for a credit agreement and must each discharge 12 of the credit obligation the case involves the dissolution of a marriage division of property and requests for compensation and maintenance the court has determined the division of both immovable and movable property in a fair manner the court has awarded a 12 share ownership of the apartment to one party and determined the order of use for different rooms each party has been awarded certain movable property the court has dismissed remaining claims and instructed the enforcement of the judgment the decision can be appealed within 30 days
